_comment: Used when the date has no file, or the file does not mention that class. Keys are class ids, plus elementary / ms-stem / hs-stem as fallbacks. minutes is the share of a full period. minMinutes is the floor. flex segments give up time first when class starts late. Copy data/content/_template.json to YYYY-MM-DD.json to replace a day.

hs-stem.title: STEM
hs-stem.standby: Find the card with your name. That is your seat. Sit down and look at the screen.

segments.title: Launch
segments.kicker: Already on the screen when you walk in
lines: Your laptop number is on your name card
Hand up when you are in

segments.title: Work time
lines: Stay on the task on the board
Table first if you get stuck

questions.q: You walk in the door. What happens first?
options: Read the screen and start the Launch Activity

questions.q: You have a question. Nobody at your table is finished yet. What do you do?
options: Ask the person next to you anyway
Put your hand up and keep working
Get up and go find an adult

questions.q: Your laptop won't charge. What do you do?
options: Take a different one off the cart
Swap with someone whose one works

ms-stem.title: STEM
ms-stem.standby: Find the card with your name. That is your seat. Sit down quietly and wait.

segments.title: Launch
segments.kicker: Already on the screen when you walk in

segments.title: Work time
lines: Help your table. Don't do it for them.

elementary.title: STEAM
elementary.standby: Come in with your teacher. Walking. Quiet voices. Look at the screen.

segments.title: Today
lines: The border tells you where your body is.
Your teacher will say the build
Nothing to touch until the screen says so.

segments.title: Build time
lines: Hand up if you need an adult
